findings.entity: olives poured from small glass bowl
findings.description: The small bowl being poured holds only green olives, yet the first olive to land in the jar (00:00.5) is dark purple, and by 01:75 roughly half the jar is dark olives. Dark olives come out of a container with no visible dark olives.

findings.entity: jar fill vs. source bowl quantity
findings.description: The small bowl visibly holds ~8-10 olives and still looks full while it pours, but the jar fills with ~20 olives by 03:00 and keeps growing to 50+ by 09:00. More olives come out than the container could hold.

findings.entity: small clear glass bottle on counter
findings.description: A small clear bottle appears on the counter right of the metal bowl. At 04:25 that same area of counter is visible and empty, and no hand places the bottle.

At 05:00 the metal bowl holds a full layer of green olives. At 05:25 it is nearly empty and holds brown pit- or nut-like items that were never there before. One handful grab can't explain the change in contents.

At 05:00-05:25 the hand grabs a bare handful of olives from the metal bowl, with no container. At 05:50 that hand is suddenly holding the small glass bowl full of olives, which had left the frame around 04:00.

No wristwatch or bracelet is visible during the first pours (00:00-03:75). A metal-band watch then appears on the reaching wrist at 04:50-05:00, and from 06:25 a chain-link bracelet is on the right wrist. The accessory appears mid-clip and its style is inconsistent.

Several of the 'dark' olives in the jar render as flat, semi-translucent slate-gray blobs with no clear outlines. They look different from the glossy purple olives that fell earlier, which is typical of generative rendering artifacts.
